title: Spinner and verb rotation
goal: Show a calm, informative working indicator: a braille spinner with a rotating verb, elapsed time and token count, drawn from the project's spinner lines with the DESIGN rules for rotation, pools and seriousness.
scope_in: `<Spinner>` line `⠹ Tentacle-wrangling…   (12s · ↑ 1.4k tokens · esc to interrupt)`: 10 braille frames `⠋ ⠙ ⠹ ⠸ ⠼ ⠴ ⠦ ⠧ ⠇ ⠏` at 80 ms in `signal`, verb in `text.muted`, meta in dim.
Elapsed time appears after 2 s, token count after 5 s, `esc to interrupt` whenever the work is interruptible; tokens format `1.4k`, `12k`, `1.2M`.

Verb picker `createVerbPicker({rng, clock, plain})`: new line every random 3-6 s (never faster than 3 s), shuffle-bag so no line repeats until all are used in the process, context pools chosen by agent state, `Absurd` pool after 30 s, max 40 characters (longer lines skipped; ≤ 24-char variant when width < 60).

Data: `packages/tui/src/spinner/lines.json` generated from `assets/The-Lines.txt` (743 lines) by `tools/spinner/build-lines.mjs`, with pools defined in `packages/tui/src/spinner/pools.json` (Default, Ocean, Signals, Code, Search, Build, Math, Absurd) keyed to CT-STATE-MAP state names.

Serious contexts use plain verbs (`Retrying…`, `Reconnecting…`, `Waiting for approval…`, `Working…`) with no jokes: auth, billing, permissions, destructive actions, and any time within the same turn after an error; `CENTO_SPINNER=plain` forces `Working…`.

Loading-pattern helper `loadingPattern(ms)` encoding DESIGN §9.4: < 100 ms nothing, 100 ms-1 s dim target only, 1-4 s spinner + verb, 4-30 s adds mascot hint `showMascot` only if allowed (>= 8 s per §10.1.9), 30 s+ adds token count and interrupt hint.
scope_out: Showing the mascot next to the line (lane C046 decides; this lane only emits the hint).
Reduced-motion static `…` rendering mode (lane C049 sets the motion context this component reads, but the static variant itself is implemented here as `motion='reduced'`).
Token counting (lane C019) and cost (lane C029).
build_against: Pure component tests with prop fixtures and the pty/TUI snapshot tester from lane C008 (ink-testing-library plus pty harness, frames captured at 80x24 and 120x40). No backend is needed; any session data comes from contracts/fixtures/events/*.json or hand-built typed values from @centcom/protocol (lane C003). Time and randomness are injected (fake clock, seeded RNG); verbs come from the checked-in lines.json produced from assets/The-Lines.txt.
interfaces: `<Spinner state: string; startedAt: Date; tokens?: number; interruptible?: boolean; width?: number; motion?: 'full'|'reduced'; serious?: boolean />`
`createVerbPicker(deps: {rng: () => number; plain?: boolean; lines?: string[]}): { next(ctx: {state: string; elapsedMs: number; width: number; serious: boolean}): string }`
acceptance: The glyph advances every 80 ms (+/-10 ms with fake clock) through the 10 frames in order and wraps.
At t=1 s the line shows glyph + verb only; at 2 s `(2s · esc to interrupt)`; at 5 s `(5s · ↑ 1.2k tokens · esc to interrupt)` when tokens are known.
Verb changes happen every 3-6 s: over 10,000 simulated seconds the minimum interval is >= 3.0 s and the maximum <= 6.0 s.
Across one process a verb is not repeated until all eligible lines were shown (shuffle-bag test over 743 draws).
No displayed verb exceeds 40 characters including `…`; at width < 60 no verb exceeds 24.

States `awaiting-approval`, `auth-required`, `session-expired`, `rate-limited`, `quota-reached`, `error`, `crash`, `deleting-file`, `reconnecting` and any state after an error in the same turn produce only plain verbs; a test asserts no line from lines.json is ever returned for them.
After 30 s the picker draws from the Absurd pool.
With `motion='reduced'` the glyph is replaced by a static `…`, the verb does not rotate faster than every 30 s, and elapsed time still updates once per second.
tests: spinner/picker.test.ts: interval bounds, shuffle bag, length limits, pools, absurd after 30 s.
spinner/serious.test.ts: state classification (every CT-STATE-MAP key classified exactly once).
spinner/render.test.ts: snapshots 80x24 and 60x20, NO_COLOR, reduced motion.
tools/spinner/build-lines.test.mjs: generated JSON matches assets/The-Lines.txt (743 entries, deduped, trimmed).
guardrails: MUST NOT show a joke line for auth, billing, permissions, destructive actions or after an error (DESIGN §14.2.4); the classification is by state name from CT-STATE-MAP.
MUST NOT use blink or flashing; the glyph changes at 12.5 Hz maximum, below the 3-flashes-per-second rule only because it is a rotating glyph (no full-line flash).
MUST NOT regenerate lines.json at install time; it is generated by the tool and committed so the runtime never reads assets/.
MUST NOT animate while the terminal is not a TTY or in screen-reader mode; render a single static line instead.
MUST keep the line a single row; truncate the meta first, then the verb.
failure_modes: lines.json missing or empty -> use the plain verb `Working…` and log once at warn.
Unknown state name -> pool `Default` and treated as non-serious (contract says unknown states are shown as generic working).
Clock goes backwards -> elapsed clamps at 0.
notes: The source file assets/The-Lines.txt is a flat list without pool tags (and 5 lines longer than 40 characters), so pools.json must be curated by hand during this lane (keyword rules plus manual overrides); this is design-asset work and should be reviewed by the design owner. Mascot appearance beside the line belongs to lane C046.
